item.title: Silicon Valley’s AI wunderkind launches Underdog, the most private Instinct/Muse competitor yet
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Sigil Wen, backed by a Silicon Valley who's who, has built an on-device AI assistant that promises to be free, fully private, and capable for everyday tasks.

item.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: On Tuesday, Musubi announced a lightweight decision model made for real-time moderation called PolicyLM-1.7B, released with open weights.

item.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.

item.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

item.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: The AI lab's personal assistant is an operating system from the future designed to compete with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.

item.title: India’s JioHotstar takes partnership route for Middle East expansion
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: JioHotstar will be offered inside Starzplay rather than through a stand-alone service.

item.title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.

item.title: Furientis lands $25M from Benchmark to mass-produce low-cost missile interceptors
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The storied Silicon Valley firm makes its first pure defense investment.

item.title: Learn all about scaling, fundraising, founder how-tos, and more at TechCrunch Founder Summit, November 4
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: There isn’t a single manual to read or prompt to give an LLM that can equip you with the skills and knowledge to build a company. But on November 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit gives founders the next-best thing: A packed day at Boston's SoWa Power Station, where investors and operators share how they've navigated crucial decisions.

item.title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: "We created this program because we believe the benefits of AI will reach most people through the companies that build on top of models, rather than through the models alone."

item.title: LibreOffice says ‘no AI’ is now a software feature
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The maker of the open source document editor says it has no plans to add AI to its software's default configuration, citing user privacy.

item.title: Vinod Khosla believes ex-DeepMind engineer’s Wajo will win agent market on trust
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Wajo's Fo agent can hire humans to complete a task.

item.title: Bluesky wants to give you your own domain on the open web
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Bluesky says the process will still take 18-24 months, so don't expect your new, shortened 'bsky' handle any time soon.

item.title: Emmys will move from broadcast TV to Prime Video in 2027
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Non-Amazon Prime subscribers will be able to watch the awards show on the platform.

item.title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.

item.title: Pinterest’s AI now turns beauty Pins into action plans
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Pinterest’s new AI-powered Beauty Guides translate hair and nail Pins into salon terminology, with estimated costs, appointment times, and maintenance needs.

item.title: Uber is spending $2.3B to get into catering
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: It's the latest in a string of deals meant to grow Uber Eats into a food delivery behemoth.

item.title: Paramount closes historic Warner Bros. merger to form Skydance
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The deal brings together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network.
